title: Sufi Traditions — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Sufism is Islam's mystical dimension, emphasizing inner devotion through poetry, music, and remembrance. The remembrance practice, called dhikr, repeats divine names in meditation. This overview edition presents Sufi Traditions within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.
